records.name: account.move.reversal.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <form string="Reverse Journal Entry">
                    <field name="residual" invisible="1"/>
                    <field name="company_id" invisible="1"/>
                    <field name="move_ids" invisible="1"/>
                    <field name="move_type" invisible="1"/>
                    <field name="available_journal_ids" invisible="1"/>
                    <group>
                        <field name="reason" invisible="move_type == 'entry'"/>
                        <field name="journal_id" domain="[('id', 'in', available_journal_ids)]"/>
                        <field name="date" required="1"/>
                    </group>
                    <footer>
                        <button string="Reverse" name="refund_moves" type="object" class="btn-primary" data-hotkey="q"/>
                        <button string="Reverse and Create Invoice" name="modify_moves" type="object" class="btn-secondary" invisible="move_type  == 'entry'"/>
                        <button string="Discard" class="btn-secondary" special="cancel" data-hotkey="x"/>
                    </footer>
               </form>
            </field>

records.name: account.move.reversal.form.inherit.l10n_es_edi_facturae
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <field name="reason" position="replace">
                    <field name="country_code" invisible="1"/>
                    <field name="l10n_es_edi_facturae_reason_code" string="Reason" invisible="country_code != 'ES'"/>
                    <field name="reason" string="Reason" invisible="country_code == 'ES'"/>
                </field>
            </field>

records.name: account.move.reversal.form.inherit.l10n_es_edi_tbai
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <xpath expr="//field[@name='journal_id']" position="after">
                <field name="l10n_es_tbai_is_required" invisible="1"/>
                <field invisible="not l10n_es_tbai_is_required" name="l10n_es_tbai_refund_reason" widget="selection"/>
            </xpath>
        </field>

records.name: account.move.reversal.form.inherit.l10n_es_edi_verifactu
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <xpath expr="//field[@name='reason']" position="after">
                    <field name="l10n_es_edi_verifactu_refund_reason" invisible="not l10n_es_edi_verifactu_required"/>
                </xpath>
            </field>

records.name: account.move.reversal.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form>
                <field name="l10n_latam_use_documents" invisible="1"/>
                <field name="l10n_latam_manual_document_number" invisible="1"/>
            </form>
            <field name="date" position="before">
                <field name="l10n_latam_available_document_type_ids" invisible="1"/>
                <field name="l10n_latam_document_type_id" invisible="not l10n_latam_use_documents" required="l10n_latam_use_documents" options="{'no_open': True, 'no_create': True}"/>
                <field name="l10n_latam_document_number" invisible="not l10n_latam_use_documents or not l10n_latam_manual_document_number" required="l10n_latam_manual_document_number and l10n_latam_use_documents"/>
            </field>
        </field>

records.name: account.move.reversal.form.inherit.l10n_sa
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <field name="journal_id" position="before">
                    <field name="l10n_sa_reason" string="ZATCA Reason" invisible="move_type == 'entry' or country_code != 'SA'"/>
                </field>
                <field name="reason" position="attributes">
                    <attribute name="invisible" separator="or" add="country_code == 'SA'"/>
                </field>
            </field>

records.name: ec_account_invoice_refund_form_inherit
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <xpath expr="//field[@name='reason']" position="attributes">
                    <attribute name="required">l10n_tw_edi_ecpay_invoice_id</attribute>
                </xpath>
                <xpath expr="//field[@name='reason']" position="after">
                    <field name="l10n_tw_edi_refund_agreement_type" invisible="not l10n_tw_edi_ecpay_invoice_id or l10n_tw_edi_is_b2b" required="l10n_tw_edi_ecpay_invoice_id"/>
                    <field name="l10n_tw_edi_allowance_notify_way" invisible="not l10n_tw_edi_ecpay_invoice_id or l10n_tw_edi_is_b2b" required="l10n_tw_edi_ecpay_invoice_id"/>
                </xpath>
            </field>

records.name: account.move.reversal.form.inherit.l10n_vn_edi
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <xpath expr="//field[@name='reason']" position="after">
                    <field name="l10n_vn_edi_adjustment_type" placeholder="Adjustment type..." invisible="country_code != 'VN'" required="country_code == 'VN'"/>
                    <field name="l10n_vn_edi_agreement_document_name" invisible="country_code != 'VN'" placeholder="Agreement document name..."/>
                    <field name="l10n_vn_edi_agreement_document_date" invisible="country_code != 'VN'" placeholder="Agreement document date..."/>
                </xpath>
            </field>
